summary: Implemented Console.set_window_title and its supporting pieces, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, checking only is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title with the second item; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skips on legacy_windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions. Nothing is committed.
